labels.name: Criticism of climate policies
labels.definition: Arguments that climate policies are ineffective, economically damaging, or driven by profit.

labels.name: Criticism of institutions and authorities
labels.definition: Arguments challenging the credibility or conduct of institutions and authorities in climate matters.

labels.name: Climate change is beneficial
labels.definition: Arguments presenting warming or increased carbon dioxide as beneficial.

labels.name: Downplaying climate change
labels.definition: Arguments minimizing climate change, its scale, human contribution, or impacts.

labels.name: Questioning the measurements and science
labels.definition: Arguments contesting climate measurements, methods, scientific evidence, or scientific credibility.

labels.name: Criticism of climate movement
labels.definition: Arguments attacking climate activists or the climate movement.

labels.name: Controversy about green technologies
labels.definition: Arguments contesting the safety, reliability, or environmental benefits of green technologies.

labels.name: Hidden plots by secret schemes of powerful groups
labels.definition: Arguments alleging hidden motives or secret coordination by powerful groups behind climate action.

labels.name: Amplifying Climate Fears
labels.definition: Arguments amplifying climate fears or presenting extreme catastrophic or fatalistic outcomes.

labels.name: Green policies are geopolitical instruments
labels.definition: Arguments portraying climate policies as instruments of geopolitical domination or exploitation.
